title: Predicting the Benefit of Retrieval Augmentation in Open-Domain Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2604.07985v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While retrieval augmented generation has become a common approach for enhancing question answering systems, retrieval is not universally advantageous. We study the problem of predicting whether incorporating external retrieved information is likely to improve response quality for a given question. To this end, we evaluate a range of prediction methods that are based on retrieval signals, answer characteristics, and semantic consistency between generated responses and retrieved passages. We further devise a predictor that probes the LLM's internal state. Its prediction performance significantly narrows the performance gap between post-generation methods which are computationally demanding and pre-generation (post-retrieval) methods. We use the prediction methods to devise a selective retrieval framework that dynamically chooses between retrieval and non-retrieval generation modes per question. translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.07985v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：虽然检索增强生成已成为增强问答系统的常见方法，但检索并非总是有利的。我们研究了预测对于给定问题，纳入外部检索信息是否可能提高回答质量的问题。为此，我们评估了一系列基于检索信号、回答特征以及生成回答与检索段落之间语义一致性的预测方法。我们进一步设计了一种探测大语言模型内部状态的预测器，其预测性能显著缩小了计算密集型的生成后方法与生成前（检索后）方法之间的性能差距。我们利用这些预测方法构建了一个选择性检索框架，该框架能够根据每个问题动态选择检索或非检索生成模式。实验结果表明，该选择性框架……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多种信号（包括LLM内部状态探测）的预测方法，用于判断检索是否有助于提升问答质量，并据此构建了动态选择检索或非检索模式的选择性框架，在性能上接近计算密集型的生成后方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes prediction methods, including probing LLM internal states, to determine whether retrieval benefits question answering, and builds a selective framework that dynamically chooses between retrieval and non-retrieval modes, approaching the performance of computationally expensive post-generation methods.
